fusions.name: Woven Sling
fusions.desc: Slings a stone from a woven cradle for 5 damage, hitting harder the further it flies, up to 1.6 times at 6.5 tiles. Anything it hits moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken Dust-Sheet
fusions.desc: You crack a dust-laden sheet out ahead of you, dealing 11 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Sandbag Brace
fusions.desc: You stack earth-filled sacks around you: a barrier absorbs the next 22 damage and your armour rises by 8% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Grave Linen
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
